title: NCSC Releases Guidance to Help Organisations Manage Cyber Risks of Agentic AI
summary: NCSC Releases Guidance to Help Organisations Manage Cyber Risks of Agentic AI Homeland Security Today
body: NCSC Releases Guidance to Help Organisations Manage Cyber Risks of Agentic AI Homeland Security Today
summaryZh: NCSC正式发布安全指南，旨在指导各组织机构有效识别并管理自主性AI智能体在实际应用中所面临的各类网络安全风险。原始信息显示：NCSC Releases Guidance to Help Organisations Manage Cyber Risks of Agentic AI Homeland Security Today。该消息由Homeland Security Today发布，主题为“NCSC Releases Guidance to Help Organisations Manage Cyber Risks of Agentic AI”。其重要性主要体现在：英国国家网络安全中心（NCSC）发布指南，帮助组织管理智能体AI（Agentic AI）带来的网络安全风险。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
